_comment: Migration apply registry. See apps/backend/scripts/check-migrations-applied.cjs and .cursor/rules/035-migration-apply-pipeline.mdc. Add new entries whenever saome_supabase MCP apply_migration succeeds. Each entry records the migration filename + applied_at timestamp + applied_by author + via mechanism.

applied.notes: Initial schema bootstrap before MCP setup.
Round 1 of data-recovery chain (Bug #8 defensive unwrap).
DB-level last-line-of-defense for non-object settings (works together with app-layer Bug #8 unwrap).
Phase 2.2 of auth-logout-batch. Schema reserved for option B/C; option A is currently active.
Hourly pg_cron job to purge expired entries from revoked_tokens. Currently has no production traffic (option A is active) but is wired for option B flip-over.

Step 5 refactor — rename notificationRadius → locationsMaxDistance (Passcreator API alignment), inject locationsDisabled:false default, backfill relevantText:null into legacy locations rows. Verified: old_key_count=0, missing_disabled=0, missing_relevant_text=0 across 34 rows; the 1 row with notificationRadius preserved value as 100.

Swap CardBuilder semantic storage: templates.name now holds Card Name (pass record name), settings.logoText holds Logo Text (pass header text), settings.storeName removed. Verified via SELECT after apply: name column carries previously-storeName values, settings has logoText key, settings has no storeName key.

Public pass registration table for /api/pass-templates/:id/register. End-user (Pass Holder) who receives the wallet card, NOT a SAOME platform member. Idempotent re-registration via UNIQUE (template_id, email). RLS enabled as defense-in-depth (backend is the only reader/writer via service role).

Tombstone table for Free-plan-safe R2 deletes. 3 enqueue sources: table-card-element-delete, template-delete, image-clear. Cron sweep every 5 min via existing worker.scheduled. RLS disabled — same pattern as revoked_tokens: backend is the only reader/writer via service role; cron sweep runs as service role.

Step 8 publish flow requires passcreator_template_id column on public.templates. Partial unique index ensures one-to-one SAOME↔Passcreator mapping; NULLs allowed for never-published drafts. See runs/decisions/2026-10-11-step8-passcreator-push.md.

Phase 3 of the Frontend Stamp Card Image Composition plan. One row per (template, fill_count) slot for pre-rendered stamp card PNGs in R2. fill_count ∈ [0, STAMP_FILL_CAP=15]; status machine (pending→uploaded→failed); partial unique index (template_id, fill_count) WHERE status='uploaded'. CardBuilder Step 3 writes 0.png; future Scanner writes 1.png~15.png. See runs/decisions/2026-10-13-stamp-card-image-composition-frontend.md.

2026-10-16 paid-membership MVP — 6 columns on public.pass_holders for the simulated Payfast/Ecpay flow: selected_tier_index, membership_tier_snapshot (JSONB), payment_provider (payfast|ecpay), payment_status (pending|completed|failed), paid_amount, currency (TWD|ZAR). Defensive TWD backfill so legacy rows don't violate the new CHECK. See runs/decisions/2026-10-16-pass-holder-paid-membership-snapshot.md.

Phase 2 of stamp-payment-status-semantic-fix. Widen public.pass_holders.payment_status CHECK from 3-value to 4-value by adding 'not_required'. Distinguishes 'paid template awaiting real gateway callback' (still 'pending') from 'non-paid template, no payment concept at all' (now 'not_required'). Stamp cards / free reward / cashback / coupon / multipass / gift / free-membership templates will emit 'not_required' instead of polluting 'pending' queries. Frontend helper and backend cross-field zod validation landed in commit 5342805 together with this migration; only the MCP apply was deferred. No data backfill — legacy rows keep 'pending' until a separate one-off sweep normalizes them. See runs/decisions/2026-10-18-payment-status-not-required-enum.md and runs/improvements/feedback/20261018-stamp-payment-status-pollution.md.

Phase 1 of pass-holder-v3-issuance plan. Extend public.pass_holders with the 5 per-pass runtime fields returned by Passcreator V3 /api/v3/pass: pass_identifier, download_url, barcode_value, issued_at, issuance_error. All columns nullable + partial unique index on pass_identifier + lookup index on issuance_error. See runs/decisions/2026-10-19-pass-holder-v3-issuance.md and runs/improvements/feedback/20261019-pass-holder-v3-issuance.md.

Phase 2 of pass-holder-v3-issuance plan. (A) Backfill 30 production pass_holders rows where barcode_value held Passcreator V3 placeholder strings ('no value given' / 'no value specified' / 'no barcode' / '') → set to NULL. (A.2) Add CHECK constraint pass_holders_barcode_value_no_placeholder_chk to prevent future placeholder writes (DB-level last-line-of-defense; complements frontend + backend parser layers). (B) Extend public.pass_holders with iphone_uri + android_uri columns so Passcreator V3's 3 URI responses (iPhoneUri / androidUri / generic) can all be persisted even when template only ships Apple + Passwallet slots. Verified after apply: barcode_null=30 / barcode_filled=0 / barcode_placeholder_remaining=0 / iphone_uri_filled=0 / android_uri_filled=0 / total=30. Scope deliberately cut short of the Hybrid JSONB refactor (3 indexed native + 4 data native) — that lives in runs/decisions/2026-10-19-pass-holder-v3-jsonb-consolidation.md as next L3 Heavy session. See runs/improvements/feedback/20261019-pass-holder-v3-issuance-data-cleanup.md.

Gift-card paid pass registration. Adds purchased_points INTEGER (CHECK > 0, nullable) + gift_card_snapshot JSONB (nullable) to public.pass_holders, plus partial index pass_holders_purchased_points_idx WHERE purchased_points IS NOT NULL for future points-balance reporting. Both columns stay NULL for every non-gift-card row (stamp / reward / membership / coupon), so no backfill needed. The exchange rate is FROZEN in gift_card_snapshot rather than recomputed, because CardBuilder Step 6 lets the tenant edit giftCardAmount / giftCardPoints at any time and a receipt rendered weeks later must show the price the customer agreed to — same pattern as membership_tier_snapshot (migration 023). paid_amount / currency already existed from migration 023 but no code path ever wrote them; this migration makes them reachable. No points ledger yet: only the opening purchase is recorded. Verified after apply: purchased_points / gift_card_snapshot present and nullable, partial index present. See runs/decisions/2026-10-23-gift-card-paid-registration.md.
